name: xrcvclibrary
description: Use XRCVC Library to explore accessible resources and perform role-authorized library operations.

author.name: Xavier's Resource Centre for the Visually Challenged

interface.shortDescription: Explore accessible resources and manage library activity.
interface.longDescription: Explore the accessible XRCVC Library catalog, then securely review or manage role-authorized catalog, account, cart, request, order, settings, report, and maintenance workflows through the XRCVC Library MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Find accessible resources in the XRCVC catalog.
Explain the items currently in my library cart.
Add a requestable item to my cart and place an order after I confirm it.
Summarize my requests, orders, and next actions.
